name: cle/timeline
title: History timeline
description: Scroll-driven horizontal timeline of milestones and Meetup events, positioned by real date. A plain list under reduced motion.

default.title: Cleveland Big Data begins
default.body: Doug Meil starts a Hadoop user group, years before anyone had "data engineer" on a business card.

default.label: August 2016
default.title: Writing down what works
default.body: Doug publishes a guide to running a technical meetup that lasts, drawn from six years of doing it.

default.title: Cleveland AI forms
default.body: A second group starts as machine learning moves out of research labs and into everyday software.

default.label: November 2024
default.title: The two groups merge
default.body: AI and data had stopped being separate conversations, so the meetups stopped being separate too.

default.label: July 2025
default.title: Hosted at KeyBank
default.body: Sixty-three people turn out for talks from Endstation, Shopify and GenomOncology.

default.label: September 2025
default.title: First Mega Meetup
default.body: The community takes over the Cleveland Museum of Natural History for the biggest night of the year.

default.label: July 2026
default.title: Summer in the Flats
default.body: Hosted by Further. FinOps for agentic AI, self-hosted infrastructure, and hard lessons from Watson Health.

default.label: August 2026
default.title: A hike, not a talk
default.body: Twenty-eight members walk the North Chagrin bridle trail. Not everything happens in a conference room.

default.label: September 28, 2026
default.title: Mega Meetup at the Museum
default.body: Five talks from AWS, Nutanix, Arista Networks, Further and OpenAI.
